senses.definition: An African animal related to a horse, with black and white stripes.
senses.example: A zebra grazed near a patch of taller grass.

senses.definition: The number for none or nothing, written as 0.
senses.example: If there are no apples left, write zero.

senses.definition: A starting point on a number scale, marked with the number 0.
senses.example: On the number line, negative three is three steps left of zero.

senses.definition: To give most of your attention to one clue, detail, or goal.
senses.example: The group began to zero in on the broken wheel as the source of the noise.

senses.definition: A tall building with wide steps or layers, built in some ancient cities of the Middle East.
senses.example: The ziggurat at Ur rose high above many other buildings.

senses.definition: A line or path that makes repeated sharp turns in alternating directions.
senses.example: The trail made a zigzag up the steep hill.

senses.definition: To follow a path with repeated sharp turns from one side to the other.
senses.example: We zigzagged around the puddles on the sidewalk.

senses.definition: To close a zipper or use a zipper to close something.
senses.example: Zip your backpack before you lift it.
The small boat zipped across the pond.

senses.definition: A fastener with two rows of pieces that lock together when you pull a small slider.
senses.example: The zipper on my jacket got caught in the cloth.

senses.definition: An area set apart for a certain purpose or with a feature that makes it different from nearby areas.
senses.example: Drivers slowed down as they entered the school zone.

senses.definition: A place where animals are kept and cared for so people can see and learn about them.
senses.example: At the zoo, we watched a keeper feed the otters.

senses.definition: To move very quickly or to change how near or far away a picture looks.
senses.example: I zoomed in on the photo to see the feathers.
